$comment: Single source of truth for Pouple's colours. The web CSS, the Swift theme, the site and the design board must match it.
rules: coral is the only accent: primary buttons, focus, 'needs your decision'. It never means an error.
fail is red-orange (hue 11) and always comes with an icon or the word; destructive buttons are outlined, never filled.
text on lavender is navy (#231F52), never ink or muted.
the mascot is one drawing with its navy outline, on every surface (light, lavender or dark): no recoloured variant.
